LanguageData.RR_FaucetPortionAutoStatus: Auto chooses a researched portion that suits the recipient.\nChildren and Maintain/Lose: Standard at 1x. Gain: prepared density.\nFood policy, stock and stomach room still apply.
LanguageData.RR_FaucetAutoMaximumDesc: Largest portion Auto may choose. Research, food supply and the recipient's needs still limit it. Fixed portions keep their own selected size.
LanguageData.RR_FaucetPortionFixedStatus: Gain requests {0} L at the prepared density. Children and Maintain/Lose receive Standard at 1x.\nThe full serving must be available and suitable for the recipient.
LanguageData.RR_FaucetPortionFixedLocked: Unavailable: {0}. The dispenser waits for this research instead of switching to another size.
LanguageData.RR_DistilleryDensityDesc: Choose a density from 1x to 5x. Concentrating changes volume, not nutrition; processing the same grade twice adds nothing. Existing mixed stock keeps its actual density.
LanguageData.RR_DistilleryLegacyLayout: Legacy port layout preserved. Reinstall this distillery to use the fixed orientation.
LanguageData.RR_FaucetDensityDesc: Gain normally follows one connected upstream distillery. With mixed or ambiguous supply, the dispenser reports an available whole-number grade; you can also choose one.\nRicher stock can be diluted, but weaker stock cannot be concentrated here. Children and Maintain/Lose receive 1x.
LanguageData.RR_FaucetDensitySupplyAmbiguous: Gain density: {0}x (no unique distillery; available grade)
LanguageData.RR_FaucetDensityReady: Prepared stock can supply this grade.
LanguageData.RR_FaucetDensityWaiting: Waiting for enough prepared stock at this grade.
